svg.title: Semaglutide and tirzepatide studies that measure pleasure
svg.desc: Of 1,006 semaglutide or tirzepatide studies registered on ClinicalTrials.gov, 4 list a validated pleasure or anhedonia scale as an outcome. All 4 are small trials, 35 to 46 people, in people with opioid, cocaine, alcohol or methamphetamine use disorders. 0 have posted results. None is in the general population taking these drugs for weight.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Does Ozempic or Zepbound dull pleasure? Almost nobody is measuring it
